description: Small Ralph self-iteration for the current branch. GitHub has no PR or Actions run for this branch yet, so scope is based on local CI health, dogfood reports, and current build/test output. Known fresh-CI risks from the previous loop were checked locally: the WebUI embed fallback and US-453 compliance report download tests are already green. The highest-priority remaining signal is a deterministic Vite production-build warning in the upper-layer offline replay bridge.

userStories.name: Quiet offline replay Web build warning
userStories.description: Remove the deterministic Vite production-build warning caused by `offlineRequestQueue.ts` being both statically and dynamically imported by the service-worker replay bridge, while preserving offline mutation replay behavior for OSv2 upper-layer workflows.
bdd_acceptance: Given the service-worker replay bridge imports the offline queue for auto replay, When the source is checked, Then it does not also dynamically import the same `offlineRequestQueue` module in a way that triggers Vite's static/dynamic import warning.
Given a service-worker replay hint arrives, When the page bridge handles the message, Then queued mutations are replayed through the canonical `executeQueuedEntry` path exactly as before.

Given the web production build runs, When Vite renders chunks, Then the build completes without the `offlineRequestQueue.ts is dynamically imported ... but also statically imported` warning obscuring real CI failures.

userStories.name: Keep local Go package discovery out of web dependencies
userStories.description: Make the local Go all-package test surface match repository code instead of traversing installed web dependency trees such as `web/node_modules/flatted/golang/pkg/flatted` after web tests or builds have installed npm packages.
bdd_acceptance: Given `web/node_modules` exists after web dependency installation, When the local Go package-list helper builds the package set for repository gates, Then packages under `web/node_modules` are excluded.
Given the CI Go job runs on a fresh checkout, When it uses the same package-list helper, Then Go test output remains scoped to Weave packages rather than accidental third-party source trees.
Given local developers run the documented Go test gate after web work, When npm dependencies are present, Then the command does not report unrelated web dependency packages.

userStories.name: Document saga read endpoints in OpenAPI
userStories.description: Close the existing contract-test TODO for saga list/get endpoints by adding their OpenAPI paths so SDK and developer-console consumers can discover the action-saga lifecycle surface.
bdd_acceptance: Given the server exposes saga list and get handlers, When the OpenAPI contract is parsed, Then both endpoints are present with stable operation IDs.
Given generated clients inspect the spec, When they search action saga endpoints, Then response shapes include saga status and step details needed by upper-layer action history experiences.
Given the contract tests run, When saga paths are removed or renamed, Then the OpenAPI contract gate fails before drift reaches SDK consumers.
